name: cold_open
text: On the twenty-ninth of September, an independent commission found Manchester City guilty of using sham sponsorship deals to inflate their finances by more than nine hundred million pounds. But there was another finding. From December twenty eighteen, while the Premier League tried to investigate, the commission said City made concerted efforts to stop and frustrate it. December twenty eighteen. Liverpool were top of the league. And for the next four years, the man trying to beat City kept telling us the same thing.

name: dortmund
text: Jürgen Klopp built his career beating money with ideas. At Borussia Dortmund, he won two league titles against Bayern Munich, a club that could outspend him every single summer. When he arrived at Liverpool in October twenty fifteen, that was the plan again. Build a team. Develop players. Spend what you earn. By twenty eighteen, it was working. Liverpool reached a Champions League final, and in the league, only one team stood in their way.

name: ninety_seven
text: The twenty eighteen nineteen season was the greatest title race the Premier League had seen. Liverpool lost one game all season. They finished with ninety-seven points. City finished with ninety-eight.

name: pep_2019
text: Three months later, Klopp said Liverpool were not in a position to keep spending like some other clubs. Pep Guardiola was asked about it.

name: pep_2019_b
text: When something is wrong, the club will be punished. Remember that line.

name: ban
text: Liverpool won the league the following season, by eighteen points. But in February twenty twenty, UEFA banned Manchester City from the Champions League for two seasons for breaking financial fair play rules. Klopp's first reaction was not to celebrate.

name: cas
text: Five months later, the Court of Arbitration for Sport overturned the ban. Some allegations were not proven. Others were too old to judge. Klopp was asked about it the next day.

name: q_cas
from: I don't think it was a good day

name: q_money
from: It's just clear where you get
to: where you get the money from

name: surprised
text: Where you get the money from. A year later, City had just paid a British record fee for Jack Grealish. Klopp was asked if their spending surprised him.

name: ninety_two
text: Twenty twenty-two. Another title race, decided on the final day. Liverpool ninety-two points. City ninety-three. One point. Again.

name: q_win_big
from: If you want to win big

name: haaland
text: That summer, City signed Erling Haaland. In October, before Liverpool played them, Klopp was asked about it. This is the press conference that opened this video, and this is how it ended.

name: q_three
to: they can do what they want

name: legal
text: Notice what he said. It's legal and everything is fine. Klopp never accused City of cheating. He just kept saying that the money was different. Four months later, the Premier League charged City with a hundred and fifteen breaches of its rules. Pep Guardiola came out fighting.

name: silent
text: And Klopp, the man who had complained about City's money for years? When the charges landed, he was asked about them. This was his answer.

name: beer
text: Klopp left Liverpool in twenty twenty-four. In January twenty twenty-five, he was asked what he would do if City were found guilty and Liverpool were handed a title.

name: verdict
text: On the twenty-ninth of September, twenty twenty-six, the commission delivered its verdict. Guilty on almost all of the charges. Sham contracts with commercial partners. More than nine hundred million pounds. And three of the four charges of failing to cooperate, upheld. By then, Klopp was the head coach of Germany. He was asked about it at a press conference.

name: fair
text: And to be fair, the financial breaches the commission found ran from two thousand and nine to twenty eighteen, before Klopp's two title races with City. City deny all wrongdoing, and they have already lodged an appeal. The punishment has not been decided. Klopp does not want a trophy from a courtroom. He never asked for one.

name: ending
text: What he did, for years, was describe the problem. Out loud. To anyone who asked. City's money was different. The competition was not the same. Someone should check where the money comes from. He was told it was an excuse. That he was bitter. That Liverpool should just spend more. Now, a commission has looked at where City's money came from.
